Resolves #21931

The Sitemap workbench now links to the Portal's Learn and Examples sections and four of their pages. The catalog record moves from Workers & Platform to More components. The workbench still lets visitors resize the map and switch themes.

Evidence: L3 headless Chromium and inspected frames at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 → L3 required.

CI jobs: +0.

Merge order. The two refreshed tiles are in [Pages #184](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/184). Merge that asset PR before this example goes into the cut.
